relationship: Painting or loading a bitmap connects image dimensions and colour depth to raw and compressed storage representations.

learnerLoop.action: Edit the bitmap or load a sample, choose a colour depth and encoding.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The pixels and derived encoded data change.
learnerLoop.evidence: Size figures, header and bitstream show how each representation stores the image.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Adjust the image or encoding to compare storage cost.

invariants: Displayed sizes derive from the bitmap and chosen encoding.
The same bitmap is the basis for each encoding comparison.
safeAdaptations: Change sample images, constraints or explanatory text while retaining the bitmap-to-storage comparison.
nonGoals: Providing a general-purpose image editor or production codec.

task.description: Compare storage methods using the same image.
task.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

controls.description: Image dimensions, colour depth, painting colour and encoding; image import, sample and clear.
controls.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

model.description: Paintable grid with pointer drag and arrow-key selection/Enter painting.
model.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

evidence.description: Selected encoded size, payload/header split, original/difference and coloured bitstream.
evidence.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

dimensions.domain: Integer width and height from 1 to 20.

depth.output: Quantised pixels, available colours and header.

size.domain: Derived payload plus header bits and packed bytes.

modes.encoding: Uncompressed, RLE and Huffman share the same pixels and colour depth.
modes.support: Open comparison; no Working or exam toggle.

dependencies: Pixel edits recalculate sizes and bitstream.
Changing depth quantises existing pixels and paint colour; a status message reports conversion.
Image imports are reduced to the supported grid. Dimensions preserve stored pixels outside the visible crop.
Shared first-use guidance identifies painting; code panes retain useful scrolling.
implementation.completion: No terminal completion; compare image patterns and storage costs.
limitations: Teaching headers/codecs are not production image formats. Pixel colours remain model data, not interface palette tokens.
